title: Reset tipper stats from the Overall System Aveva API page (Reset Tipper Stats)
summary: Use the “Reset Tipper Stats” control on the UPSHMI “Overall System Aveva API” page to manually reset tipper metrics/stats. The source also states tipper metrics reset automatically when a new sort plan is loaded, but the same metrics can be manually reset from this page.
when_to_use: When tipper metrics/stats need to be cleared and re-initialized manually from the UPSHMI “Overall System Aveva API” page using the “Reset Tipper Stats” control.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the manual “Reset Tipper Stats” action on the UPSHMI “Overall System Aveva API” page and confirm the metrics reflect the reset.
access_or_tools_needed: UPSHMI access to the “Overall System Aveva API” page

access_required: UPSHMI access to the “Overall System Aveva API” page
system_preconditions: The “Overall System Aveva API” page is available in UPSHMI and shows the “Reset Tipper Stats” control.

visual_references.description: UPSHMI “Overall System Aveva API” page showing “Reset Tipper Stats” and the statement that metrics reset on new sort plan load but can also be manually reset.

steps.title: Open the “Overall System Aveva API” page in UPSHMI
steps.purpose: Access the page that contains the “Reset Tipper Stats” control.
steps.instruction: In UPSHMI, open the “Overall System Aveva API” page.
steps.expected_result: The “Overall System Aveva API” page is displayed and includes the “Reset Tipper Stats” control.
steps.healthy_condition: The page content is visible (not blank) and the “Reset Tipper Stats” label/control is present on-screen.
steps.failure_condition: The page does not load correctly (e.g., blank/does not display the controls), or the “Reset Tipper Stats” control is not visible.

actions.label: Open Overall System Aveva API page
actions.exact_action: Open the “Overall System Aveva API” page in UPSHMI.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the page does not display the “Reset Tipper Stats” control, stop and escalate for deeper troubleshooting.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR shows “Reset Tipper Stats” on the “Overall System Aveva API” page and states: “Metrics are reset when a new sort plan is loaded but can also be manually reset.”

steps.title: Locate the “Reset Tipper Stats” control on the page
steps.purpose: Identify the exact on-screen control used to trigger the manual reset.
steps.instruction: On the “Overall System Aveva API” page, find the “Reset Tipper Stats” control.
steps.expected_result: The “Reset Tipper Stats” control is located and ready to be used.
steps.healthy_condition: The “Reset Tipper Stats” label/control is clearly visible on the page.
steps.failure_condition: The “Reset Tipper Stats” control cannot be found or is not visible.

actions.label: Find Reset Tipper Stats
actions.exact_action: Locate the “Reset Tipper Stats” control on the page.

stop_or_escalate_if: If “Reset Tipper Stats” is not visible, stop and escalate for deeper troubleshooting.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR includes “Reset Tipper Stats” on the “Overall System Aveva API” page.

steps.title: Perform the manual reset action for “Reset Tipper Stats”
steps.purpose: Trigger a manual reset of tipper metrics/stats from the Aveva API page.
steps.instruction: Use the “Reset Tipper Stats” control on the “Overall System Aveva API” page to perform the manual reset action.
steps.expected_result: The manual reset action is executed (tipper metrics/stats are reset as described by the source).
steps.healthy_condition: After the action, the tipper metrics/stats reflect a reset state (i.e., the metrics are cleared/zeroed per the reset behavior tied to sort plan GUID/metrics reset).
steps.failure_condition: Tipper metrics/stats do not change after the manual reset action.

actions.label: Reset tipper stats
actions.exact_action: Perform the manual reset action for “Reset Tipper Stats.”

stop_or_escalate_if: If tipper stats do not change after the manual reset action, stop and escalate for deeper troubleshooting.
If “Get errors” shows current errors, do not assume reset alone resolves the underlying issue.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript nearby states: “They hit A tag and it resets the metric.” OCR states: “Metrics are reset when a new sort plan is loaded but can also be manually reset.”

steps.title: Verify that tipper stats/metrics have been reset
steps.purpose: Confirm the reset took effect on the live metrics display.
steps.instruction: Check the tipper metrics/stats area on the UPSHMI “Overall System Aveva API” page (or the metrics view opened from this page) to confirm the values reflect the reset.
steps.expected_result: Tipper stats/metrics show the reset effect consistent with the source statement that metrics reset on new sort plan load and can also be manually reset.
steps.healthy_condition: Tipper metrics/stats appear cleared/zeroed after the reset action (reset behavior tied to metrics reset).
steps.failure_condition: Tipper stats/metrics do not reflect any reset effect after the manual reset action.

actions.label: Confirm reset effect
actions.exact_action: Verify that tipper stats/metrics have been reset.

stop_or_escalate_if: If tipper stats do not change after the manual reset action, stop and escalate for deeper troubleshooting.
If “Get errors” shows current errors, do not assume reset alone resolves the underlying issue.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR and transcript state that metrics are reset when a new sort plan is loaded but can also be manually reset from this page.

success_criteria: After using “Reset Tipper Stats,” the displayed tipper metrics/stats reflect a reset (cleared/zeroed) state consistent with the source’s reset behavior.
healthy_conditions: Tipper metrics/stats update to reflect the reset effect after the manual reset action.
failure_conditions: Tipper stats/metrics do not change after the manual reset action.
Current errors are present when checking via “Get errors,” indicating reset alone may not resolve the underlying issue.
escalation_guidance: If tipper stats do not change after the manual reset action, stop and escalate for deeper troubleshooting.
If “Get errors” shows current errors, do not assume reset alone resolves the underlying issue; escalate for deeper troubleshooting.
